talent.kittytalents.nine_lives.desc: Every cat has 5 free ranks. Once per recharge, a fatal blow is survived instead; higher ranks restore more health and recharge faster.
talent.kittytalents.pounce.desc: Every cat stalks and pounces in combat. Each rank adds reach, a shorter cooldown, and a higher, harder-hitting leap.
talent.kittytalents.night_prowler.desc: Drastically repels Creepers & Phantoms; grants night vision.
talent.kittytalents.kitty_pack.desc: Equips the cat with a backpack (up to 27 storage slots).
talent.kittytalents.lucky_purr.desc: Emits an aura of Luck and Regeneration to nearby owners.
talent.kittytalents.mouser.desc: Hunts small pests and brings you presents when you wake up.
talent.kittytalents.fisher_cat.desc: Paws at water and catches fresh fish and ocean treasures.
talent.kittytalents.feline_agility.desc: Boosts movement speed, high jumps, and projectile dodge chance.
talent.kittytalents.pillow_cat.desc: Heals rapidly when resting on beds, chests, or comfy surfaces.
talent.kittytalents.whisker_radar.desc: Alerts you with meows when monsters lurk nearby.
talent.kittytalents.cat_mount.desc: Increases cat size and allows you to ride and steer your battle cat!
talent.kittytalents.cat_armory.desc: Allows equipping swords in mouth, heavy attack power, and fire slash.
talent.kittytalents.cat_armor.desc: Allows equipping armor for great defense and damage reduction.
talent.kittytalents.happy_eater.desc: Improves digestion, cuts hunger drain, and allows safely eating all meats.
talent.kittytalents.aqua_kitty.desc: Breathes underwater, swims with Dolphin Grace, and attacks aquatic threats.
talent.kittytalents.pest_hunter.desc: Critical strikes against Spiders, Silverfish, Endermites, Bats, and Phantoms.
talent.kittytalents.torch_kitty.desc: Emits bioluminescent feline glow in darkness, lighting caves and paths.
talent.kittytalents.home_whiskers.desc: Each rank speeds up the trip home; from rank 3 a cat far from home finds its way back instantly.
talent.kittytalents.purr_medic.desc: Purrs to heal injured owner and allies with Regeneration and Absorption.
talent.kittytalents.feline_berserker.des: Enters raging frenzy at low health; rapid attack speed and lethal claws.
talent.kittytalents.feline_hiss.desc: Unleashes ranged ultrasonic hisses and arcane sonic claws at distant foes.
talent.kittytalents.sky_feline.desc: Cat sprouts celestial wings! Grants flight when riding and air assault.
talent.kittytalents.mole_cat.desc: Cat digs through underground stone and unearths rare minerals & diamonds!
talent.kittytalents.frenzy_focus.desc: Enhances the duration and stats of Frenzy Cat Milk.
talent.kittytalents.shadow_pelt.desc: Reduces mob detection range and grants sneak attack critical strikes.
talent.kittytalents.guardian_cat.desc: Boosts defense, knockback resistance, and raises an alarm hiss against intruders.
talent.kittytalents.hunter_cat.desc: +2.5 damage per rank against animals, and each rank gives a 10% chance to double an animal's drops.
talent.kittytalents.inferno_cat.desc: Complete fire immunity; ignites enemies on claw contact with flame trails.
talent.kittytalents.venom_claws.desc: Claw strikes inflict lethal Poison, Weakness, and Wither.
talent.kittytalents.rescue_purr.desc: Rushes to critically injured allies to provide emergency health and shielding.
talent.kittytalents.herding_kitty.desc: Herds livestock and farm animals together, following behind the player.
talent.kittytalents.gale_purr.desc: Unleashes an ultrasonic shockwave when crowded, blowing away enemies.
talent.kittytalents.charm_whiskers.desc: Charms villagers for trading discounts and pacifies aggressive foes.
talent.kittytalents.water_pelt.desc: Douses burning allies, carries water, and extinguishes blaze fireballs.
talent.kittytalents.kitty_tools.desc: Allows equipping tools (Pickaxe, Axe, Shovel, Hoe, Fishing Rod) for work.
talent.kittytalents.cushion_paws.desc: Absorbs explosion blasts, lightning strikes, and kinetic impact.
talent.kittytalents.paw_retriever.desc: Collects dropped items and retrieves specific entities/prey to owner.
talent.kittytalents.fireproof_paws.desc: Walks across lava and magma blocks as solid scorched obsidian surfaces.
talent.kittytalents.sniffer_whiskers.des: Sniffs out buried seeds, fossils, ancient pottery sherds, and gems.
talent.kittytalents.gate_purr.desc: Opens fence gates as you walk through with the cat, and closes them behind you.
talent.kittytalents.alchemy_kitty.desc: Dire alchemy: brews beneficial buffs and purges negative debuffs.
talent.kittytalents.catnip_catastrophe.d: Supercharged dire explosive catnip burst dealing massive AoE damage.
talent.kittytalents.farmer_cat.desc: Harvests mature crops, replants seeds, and accelerates crop growth in its work area.
talent.kittytalents.lumber_cat.desc: Fells trees top-down and replants saplings in its work area.
talent.kittytalents.courier_cat.desc: Transports and sorts items between linked input and output containers.
talent.kittytalents.sharpshooter.desc: Increases firearm accuracy, effective range, and critical damage with TacZ guns.
talent.kittytalents.tactical_reload.desc: Speeds up firearm reloading and enables automatic reload when out of combat.
talent.kittytalents.ammo_scavenger.desc: Grants a chance not to consume ammo on shot and scavenges ammo from slain foes.
talent.kittytalents.green_paw.desc: Unlocks the Farmer job: harvests and replants crops. Rank 3 bonemeals young crops; rank 5 tills soil near water.
talent.kittytalents.timber_claws.desc: Unlocks the Lumberjack job: fells trees, collects logs and replants saplings.
talent.kittytalents.logistics_whiskers.d: Unlocks the Courier job (moves filtered items between containers). Rank 3 unlocks the Sorter job.
talent.kittytalents.work_ethic.desc: Each rank makes job tasks 8% faster and reduces hunger drain while working.
talent.kittytalents.marksman.desc: Gun damage +8% per rank and aims down sights. Rank 3 aims for the head and adds headshot damage.
talent.kittytalents.quick_reload.desc: Reloads from the Kitty Pack when a normal reload fails. Rank 3 always reloads instantly.
talent.kittytalents.gunsmith_paw.desc: Allows crafting TacZ ammunition (Lv10+) and attachments (Lv25+) at a Gun Smith Table.
talent.kittytalents.ballistic_vest.desc: Reduces incoming projectile, explosion, and gunfire damage.
jei.kittytalents.kitty_work_clipboard.in: Right-click a Talented Cat to select it. Sneak + Right-click a cat to cycle its job. Right-click a Kitty Work Station to bind the cat. Right-click a Kitty Habitat to house the cat inside (Sneak + Right-click to release). Sneak + Right-click containers to set Input/Output chests, or blocks to set Work Area corners.
jei.kittytalents.kitty_habitat.info: Houses a Talented Cat inside (via Kitty Work Clipboard) to passively produce resources based on the cat's tier, level, and talents. Accepts food, catalysts, Productivity Upgrades, and optional Forge Energy (FE) for +100% speed.
jei.kittytalents.kitty_work_station.info: Automation hub for bound worker cats. Buffers harvested items (18 slots), supplies seeds/tools/food/ammo (4 slots), accepts up to 2 Productivity Upgrades, and supports hoppers/item pipes on all sides.
jei.kittytalents.treat_oven.info: Bakes Catnip Treats, Tiered Ore Treats, and Feline Feasts using furnace fuel. Optional Forge Energy (FE) doubles baking speed.
jei.kittytalents.kitty_whistle.info: Commands all owned cats within 64 blocks. Sneak + Right-click to cycle commands (Recall, Heel, Attack, Sit/Stand, Guard, Frenzy Rally, Clock In, Clock Out).
jei.kittytalents.treats.info: Feed treats to tamed cats to awaken them into Talented Cats and train them up to Level 100.
tooltip.kittytalents.treat_levels: Can train cats from level %d to %d

message.kittytalents.must_tame_first: You must tame this cat with raw fish before training it!

message.kittytalents.needs_milk: Your cat is down! Nurse them back with Warm Milk or a Golden Apple.
message.kittytalents.treat_too_low: Your cat has outgrown this treat! Use a higher tier treat.
message.kittytalents.no_pack: This cat needs at least 1 point in Kitty Pack to carry items!
message.kittytalents.cat_frenzy: %s drank Frenzy Cat Milk and entered SUPER FELINE FRENZY!
message.kittytalents.frenzy_cooldown: %s is resting from Frenzy! Please wait before feeding more Frenzy Milk.
message.kittytalents.need_higher_armory: Requires Cat Armory Rank %d to equip %s!
message.kittytalents.need_higher_armor: Requires Feline Armor Rank %d to equip %s!
message.kittytalents.need_armory_talent: Your cat needs the Cat Armory talent to wield weapons!
message.kittytalents.need_armor_talent: Your cat needs the Feline Armor talent to wear armor!
message.kittytalents.need_dire_treat: Unlocking this end-game skill requires 1 Dire Treat in your inventory!
message.kittytalents.dire_awakened: %s has consumed a Dire Treat and achieved DIRE AWAKENING! End-game talents unlocked!
message.kittytalents.dire_level_req: %s must reach Level %d before Dire Awakening can be achieved!

message.kittytalents.need_respec_elixir: You need a Catnip Respec Elixir in your inventory to respec talents!
message.kittytalents.perm.owner_only: Only the cat's owner can do that.
message.kittytalents.perm.too_far: Your cat is too far away.
message.kittytalents.bed_linked: Linked %s to this Cat Bed as their home!
message.kittytalents.no_cat_near_bed: No owned cats nearby to link to this bed. Bring your cat close!
message.kittytalents.trust_added: %s is now a trusted co-owner of %s!
message.kittytalents.trust_received: You were trusted with %s by %s! You can now command, ride and equip them.
message.kittytalents.trust_player_not_fo: Player '%s' is not online. Co-owners must be real players currently on the server.
message.kittytalents.no_item_for_slot: Nothing in your inventory fits that slot.
message.kittytalents.trust_revoked: You are no longer a co-owner of %s.
talent.kittytalents.feline_reflexes.desc: Hones supernatural agility and hyper-fast dodging, granting a chance to completely parry incoming physical and projectile attacks.
talent.kittytalents.critical_claws.desc: Sharpens the cat's razor claws, granting a stacking chance to deal critical bleeding damage on melee and pounce attacks.
combat.kittytalents.perfect_dodge: Perfect Dodge! %s slipped past the attack.
talent.kittytalents.nine_lives.mastery: Tenth Life: the revive restores full health, grants Resistance II and recharges twice as fast.
talent.kittytalents.pounce.mastery: Apex Pounce: pounce landings stun foes (heavy Slowness and Weakness).
talent.kittytalents.night_prowler.master: Cat's Eyes: your owner gets Night Vision while near the cat.
talent.kittytalents.kitty_pack.mastery: Bottomless Pack: items the cat walks over go straight into its pack.
talent.kittytalents.lucky_purr.mastery: Fortune's Favorite: Luck is one level higher and Regeneration becomes Regeneration II.
talent.kittytalents.mouser.mastery: Exterminator: pests die in a single hit.
talent.kittytalents.fisher_cat.mastery: Catch of the Day: a cooked fish appears in the cat's pack every 5 minutes.
talent.kittytalents.feline_agility.maste: Ghost Step: the cat can also dodge melee attacks (15% chance).
talent.kittytalents.pillow_cat.mastery: Dream Weaver: your owner regenerates while sleeping near the cat.
talent.kittytalents.whisker_radar.master: Sixth Sense: detected hostiles glow so you can see them through walls.
talent.kittytalents.cat_mount.mastery: War Steed: the rider gains Resistance while mounted.
talent.kittytalents.cat_armory.mastery: Blademaster: the equipped weapon slowly repairs itself.
talent.kittytalents.cat_armor.mastery: Living Armor: worn armor slowly repairs itself (free Mending).
talent.kittytalents.feline_reflexes.mast: Perfect Reflexes: the perfect-dodge window is twice as long.
talent.kittytalents.critical_claws.maste: Executioner: +50% damage to foes below 30% health.
talent.kittytalents.happy_eater.mastery: Bottomless Belly: hunger never drops below half.
talent.kittytalents.aqua_kitty.mastery: Tidecaller: your owner swims with Dolphin's Grace and Water Breathing near the cat.
talent.kittytalents.pest_hunter.mastery: Exterminator's Hide: pests deal half damage and the cat cannot be poisoned.
talent.kittytalents.torch_kitty.mastery: Everburning: placing torches no longer uses them up.
talent.kittytalents.home_whiskers.master: Hearth: the cat arrives home fully healed.
talent.kittytalents.purr_medic.mastery: Field Medic: also heals trusted players and your other pets nearby.
talent.kittytalents.feline_berserker.mas: Unbreakable: below 40% health the cat takes 30% less damage.
talent.kittytalents.feline_hiss.mastery: Banshee Hiss: every hiss volley fires two projectiles.
talent.kittytalents.shadow_pelt.mastery: Umbral Cloak: your owner is also hidden in darkness near the cat.
talent.kittytalents.guardian_cat.mastery: Bulwark: the cat absorbs 25% of the damage its owner takes nearby.
talent.kittytalents.hunter_cat.mastery: Big Game: every kill (not just animals) drops double loot.
talent.kittytalents.inferno_cat.mastery: Phoenix: immune to fire, and burning foes take 30% more damage.
talent.kittytalents.venom_claws.mastery: Toxic Bloom: killing a foe spreads poison to enemies around it.
talent.kittytalents.rescue_purr.mastery: Guardian Angel: a rescue also grants your owner Resistance IV for 5 seconds.
talent.kittytalents.herding_kitty.master: Shepherd: baby animals near the cat grow up faster.
talent.kittytalents.gale_purr.mastery: Hurricane: the gust triggers even against a single foe.
talent.kittytalents.charm_whiskers.maste: Village Darling: villagers near the cat restock their trades every minute.
talent.kittytalents.water_pelt.mastery: Tideborn: your owner gets Conduit Power in water near the cat.
talent.kittytalents.kitty_tools.mastery: Master Craftscat: the equipped tool slowly repairs itself.
talent.kittytalents.cushion_paws.mastery: Featherfall: your owner takes no fall damage near the cat.
talent.kittytalents.paw_retriever.master: Magnet Paws: retrieved items go straight into the cat's pack.
talent.kittytalents.fireproof_paws.maste: Flameward: your owner gets Fire Resistance near the cat.
talent.kittytalents.sniffer_whiskers.mas: Treasure Nose: digs can turn up gold, emeralds or diamonds.
talent.kittytalents.gate_purr.mastery: Doorman: also opens (and closes) doors for you.
talent.kittytalents.green_paw.mastery: Harvest Moon: crops near the cat grow faster.
talent.kittytalents.timber_claws.mastery: Forest Friend: saplings near the cat grow faster.
talent.kittytalents.logistics_whiskers.m: Express Delivery: +20% move speed while working.
talent.kittytalents.marksman.mastery: Deadeye: headshots deal even more damage.
talent.kittytalents.quick_reload.mastery: Speed Loader: the gun is topped up from the pack every few seconds.
talent.kittytalents.ammo_scavenger.maste: Scrounger: every gun kill puts 2 rounds back in the magazine.
talent.kittytalents.sky_feline.mastery: Stormrider: your owner falls slowly near the cat.
talent.kittytalents.mole_cat.mastery: Prospector: underground, your owner gets Haste II near the cat.
talent.kittytalents.frenzy_focus.mastery: Bloodlust: melee hits heal the cat for 20% of the damage dealt.
talent.kittytalents.alchemy_kitty.master: Splash Brew: hit afflictions splash onto foes around the target, and each hit pulls your harmful effects off you and onto that enemy.
talent.kittytalents.catnip_catastrophe.m: Second Wind: the emergency shockwave also heals the cat by 30%.
message.kittytalents.twine_leash: Too far from your body - your cat can't go further.
